pages.title: Censer of Entropy
pages.text: Swing it and the world remembers how to decay. Any affliction, on one creature or on a place.

Sneak-use to choose any harmful effect of any mod, its level (up to 255), how long it lasts (up to an hour) and the radius of its cloud. Use on a creature to lay it on; use in the air to leave a lingering cloud up to 48 blocks away.
